body.x: Today, January 7, 2018 (in local time) is the second day of the Media Days event (Consumer Technology Show) of the world’s best IT home appliance exhibition “CES 2018” in Las Vegas, USA.

On this day Panasonic introduced the 3rd generation communication network technology in the press conference. Especially, it presented how this technology is applied to cars while it is utilizing the Auto of Amazon for the presentation. As Alexa of Amazon is grafted into the car, the user can drive more conveniently while accessing to the weather information, utilizing the navigation system, and adjusting the temperature inside the car. Also, the user can manage the user’s schedule, and control things inside the user’s house.

Further, Panasonic introduced high-function next generation EV battery; solutions for digitalizing retail businesses, restaurants, agencies, food-supplying chains; and realistic entertainment technology.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
